faq.question: Can I apply to more than one scholarship listed here?
faq.answer: Usually, you can explore and apply to multiple programs if you meet each listing’s rules. Treat every row as a separate scholarship with its own official requirements, deadline, and submission process.

faq.question: What kinds of scholarships are included in this California women-focused list?
faq.answer: These rows span several categories, including education, medicine, law, STEM, arts, and miscellaneous topics in the USA context. Sample listings also suggest different study levels, such as high school seniors and adult non-traditional students.

faq.question: Do all of these scholarships have the same deadline or award amount?
faq.answer: No—deadlines differ by program, and the dates shown in these rows are not one universal deadline for the whole page. Award amounts also vary by listing, so confirm the current amount and timing on the official source before you apply.
